python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Maturity totals (in millions)
values = [24221, 22764, 33368, 28378, 35919]

# Calculate average
n = len(values)
average = sum(values) / n
print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"Average: {average}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
# Using the formula: sqrt(sum((x - avg)^2) / (n - 1))
variance = sum((x - average) ** 2 for x in values) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample standard deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate how many standard deviations 1972 (first value) is from the average
z = (values[0] - average) / std_dev
print(f"\n1972 value ({values[0]}) is {z:.3f} standard deviations from the 5-year average")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(z, 3)}")
EOF
